review_method.source_visual: 600 dpi render from original PDF; notehead centers reviewed against staff geometry and local cue-source labels.
review_method.omr_candidate: Audiveris 5.11, MusicXML note events cross-referenced to source pixel geometry.
review_method.pitch_confidence: High for systems 1–2 where notehead geometry and MusicXML pitch agree; medium for systems 3–5 because printed accidental/key glyphs are heavy and harder to distinguish.
review_method.note_completeness: Every unmatched raw OMR candidate in systems 1–5 was reviewed at 600 dpi and classified as added part/cue note or non-note. Cue events remain in notes with source_role=cue and must be excluded from Horn II playback.
review_method.cue_handling: Printed cue labels checked: Viol I (system 1, measure 3), Vc./Cb. (system 3, measure 18), Trb. (D) (system 3, measure 20), Timp. (system 5, measure 39).

uncertainties: System 1 m3 contains Viol I cue notation: these source-visible pitches are retained with source_role=cue and must not be played as Horn II.
System 1 m5 added D4 and C4 heads are visually distinct, but their rhythmic values could not be recovered confidently from the scan; duration_quarters is null.
System 4 m33 extra D4 head is visible but its rhythmic value is unresolved; it is included as a medium-confidence Horn II part note.
System 1 cue B5 heads are read as natural because no key signature is printed/detected in the opening system; verify against a cleaner source if that key signature is later found.

System 3 measure 18 key signature is one flat (B-flat); the printed key-signature flat is applied to B4. System 3 measure 19 has explicit F-flat and the second F-flat is carried in the same measure; down-a-fifth concert spelling is B-double-flat3.
Duration values from MusicXML are retained for matched events; added heads have null duration because their value is not secure.
